events.text:
La hipoxia reprograma la expresión génica de forma específica de cada tejido, favoreciendo adaptación energética, vascular e inmune. En cordero recién nacido se pierde el programa pardo del tejido graso, en adenocarcinoma pulmonar se amplifica un programa tumoral y de resistencia, y en otro cáncer marca un endotelio angiogénico distinto; no son comparables directamente.

Síntesis inicial basada en resúmenes recuperados; la verificación detallada sigue en curso.

claims.text: Observe que el ARNm de DIO2 fue significativamente menor en ambos grupos LTH comparados con controles.
claims.quote: DIO2 mRNA was significantly lower in both LTH-SL and LTH-HA compared to control ( Figure 3(a ))

claims.text: Considere que los controles se gestaron en normoxia y los LTH en hipoxia gestacional moderada, mantenidos luego en HA o SL hasta 14 días posnatales.
claims.quote: 14-day old control (CONT) lambs gestated and delivered under normoxic conditions, and 14-day old lambs exposed to long term moderate gestational hypoxia in utero (LTH) then maintained post-birth at either high altitude (HA) or near sea level (SL) through 14 days’ post-birth.

claims.text: Considere que las concentraciones de ARNm se reportaron como fg de ARNm por 50 ng de ARN total en grasa perirrenal.
claims.quote: Messenger RNA concentrations (fg mRNA per 50 ng total RNA) for Uncoupling Protein 1 (UCP1) (a) and leptin (b) in perirenal fat from 14-day old control (CONT) lambs gestated and delivered under normoxic conditions,

claims.text: Tenga en cuenta que no se pudo detectar UCP1 por Western aun cargando hasta 100 ug de proteína.
claims.quote: we could not detect UCP1 via Western analysis despite loading up to 100 ug of protein.

claims.text: Observe que el ARNm de DIO2 fue significativamente menor en ambos grupos LTH comparados con controles.
claims.quote: DIO2 mRNA was significantly lower in both LTH-SL and LTH-HA compared to control ( Figure 3(a ))

events.reason: source support could not be confirmed

claims.text: Considere que la expresion del ARNm de SATB2 se indujo marcadamente por hipoxia en lineas LUAD.
claims.quote: RT-qPCR analysis showed that SATB2 mRNA expression was markedly induced by hypoxia across these LUAD cell lines ( Fig. 1A ).

claims.text: Considere que los niveles de proteina SATB2 se midieron por western blot en celulas LUAD tratadas con hipoxia.
claims.quote: western blot analysis revealed increased SATB2 protein levels accompanied by HIF-1α stabilization in hypoxia-treated LUAD cells ( Fig. 1B and Supplementary Fig. 1A).

claims.text: Considere que la hipoxia aplicada fue 1% O2 durante 24 h frente a normoxia 20% O2.
claims.quote: cultured under normoxic conditions (20% O₂) or hypoxic conditions (1% O₂) for 24 h.

claims.text: Considere que la delecion de SATB2 redujo marcadamente la expresion inducida por hipoxia de VEGFA, EPO y LOX.
claims.quote: RT-qPCR further showed that SATB2 knockout markedly impaired the hypoxia-induced expression of the representative HIF target genes VEGFA, EPO, and LOX in A549 cells (Supplementary Fig. 1I).

claims.text: Considere que la perdida de HIF-1alfa redujo marcadamente la expresion de SATB2 en normoxia e hipoxia.
claims.quote: Loss of HIF-1α led to a marked reduction in SATB2 expression under both normoxic and hypoxic conditions.

claims.text: Considere que los genes HIF1A, VEGFA, SLC2A1, PGK1, PDK1, LOX, LDHA, ENO1, CA9, BNIP3, ALDOA y ADM se localizan en regiones tumorales.
claims.quote: Spatial feature mapping demonstrated that representative hypoxia-responsive genes, including HIF1A, VEGFA, SLC2A1, PGK1, PDK1, LOX, LDHA, ENO1, CA9, BNIP3, ALDOA, and ADM, exhibited broad spatial localization across tumor-associated regions (Supplementary Fig. 3).

claims.text: Considere que la mayoría de genes asociados a hipoxia se expresan más en regiones malignas y mixtas que en tejido normal.
claims.quote: Comparison across spatially annotated tissue regions further revealed that most hypoxia-associated genes were significantly more highly expressed in malignant and mixed regions than in normal tissue ( Fig. 8A ).

claims.text: Considere que HIF1A, VEGFA, SLC2A1, PGK1, LOX, BNIP3, LDHA y ALDOA se enriquecen en nichos tumorales y PDK1 en regiones malignas.
claims.quote: Among these genes, HIF1A, VEGFA, SLC2A1, PGK1, LOX, BNIP3, LDHA, and ALDOA showed robust enrichment in tumor-associated niches, whereas PDK1 was preferentially elevated in malignant regions relative to normal tissue.

claims.text: Considere integrar genes individuales relacionados con hipoxia en una puntuación de módulo para medir la actividad global de la vía.
claims.quote: To further characterize the spatial microenvironment associated with hypoxia signaling, we integrated individual hypoxia-related genes into a module score representing overall hypoxia pathway activity.

claims.text: Considere usar los algoritmos SingScore, UCell y VAM para evaluar asociaciones espaciales relacionadas con hipoxia.
claims.quote: Comparable cell-type association patterns were consistently observed using multiple pathway-scoring algorithms, including SingScore, UCell, and VAM, supporting the robustness of these hypoxia-related spatial associations (Supplementary Fig. 4).

claims.text: Considere que los análisis de correlación de señalización hipóxica no establecen comunicación directa entre células.
claims.quote: as correlation analyses, they do not establish direct cell-cell communication.

claims.text: Considere que SATB2 es inducido por hipoxia y regulado directamente por HIF-1α mediante unión al promotor.
claims.quote: We found that SATB2 expression was induced by hypoxia and directly regulated by HIF-1α through promoter binding.

claims.text: Considere HIF1A, VEGFA, SLC2A1, PGK1, LOX, LDHA, BNIP3 y ALDOA como genes de respuesta a hipoxia similarmente enriquecidos.

geneticContext.gene: HIF1A, VEGFA, SLC2A1, PGK1, LOX, LDHA, BNIP3, and ALDOA

claims.quote: multiple hypoxia-responsive genes, including HIF1A, VEGFA, SLC2A1, PGK1, LOX, LDHA, BNIP3, and ALDOA, displayed similar enrichment patterns.

claims.text: Evalúe la respuesta a hipoxia de SATB2 en LUAD mediante ensayos de reportero de luciferasa y ChIP.
claims.quote: Luciferase reporter and ChIP assays supported SATB2 as a hypoxia-responsive chromatin regulator in LUAD.

claims.text: Evalúe programas de SATB2 e hipoxia en tejidos humanos de LUAD mediante análisis transcriptómicos espaciales.
claims.quote: In this study, spatial transcriptomic analyses extended our mechanistic observations from cellular and murine models to human LUAD tissues.

claims.text: Considere que la pérdida de SATB2 reduce la acetilación H3K27 y la ocupación de la ARN polimerasa II en elongación.
claims.quote: Loss of SATB2 reduced H3K27 acetylation and elongating RNA polymerase II occupancy at representative HIF-1 target genes

claims.text: Considere que la deficiencia de SATB2 reduce selectivamente la ocupación de ARN polimerasa II–S2P con efectos limitados en formas totales y S5P.
claims.quote: SATB2 deficiency selectively reduced RNA polymerase II–S2P occupancy, while exerting limited effects on total RNA polymerase II and RNA polymerase II–S5P occupancy at representative HIF-1 target loci.

claims.text: Considere SATB2 como regulador epigenético inducible por hipoxia identificado en LUAD.
claims.quote: we identify SATB2 as a previously unrecognized hypoxia-inducible epigenetic regulator in LUAD.

claims.text: Considere que HIF-1α, a diferencia de HIF-2α, promueve la expresión de SATB2 en ambientes hipóxicos.
claims.quote: HIF-1α, unlike HIF-2α, directly interacts with the promoter of SATB2, promoting its expression in hypoxic environments.

claims.text: Considere que SATB2 amplifica la señalización HIF-1 y activa genes de respuesta a hipoxia.
claims.quote: SATB2 epigenetically amplifies HIF-1 signaling and activates hypoxia-responsive genes.

claims.text: Evalúe los programas hipóxicos asociados a SATB2 mediante transcriptómica espacial en nichos tumorales malignos.

geneticContext.effect: preferentially enriched within malignant tumor niches

claims.quote: Spatial transcriptomic analyses further show that SATB2-associated hypoxic programs are preferentially enriched within malignant tumor niches and are associated with remodeling of the local tumor microenvironment.
